split_tp_v1_scope: split_tp_v1.json does not cover training_part03. Its rule text reads 'train = every other event of the nine parts', but its scope field limits the rule to the two streamed parts (training_part01, training_part02). training_part03 was never streamed and no model has read any of its events; under addendum H its events are H-test hosts and spares only.
overlay_id_rule: overlay id = 50,000,000 + 1,000,000 * k + host id (TrackML ids are below 1,000,000)

hval.role: development, gates V2 and V3, C1 confirmation; val estimate of H1 after the overlay_hash commit; no claim

closure.role: gate V1: native val targets of the V1 populations removed and simulated again by the overlay chain; no gun LLPs

htest.hosts: training_part03 by the H-test hash rule (ids added at H-T1)

pilot.role: H-P dry run only; not used for any result
pilot.note: hosts = the first five tp_v1 val ids in increasing key('canto-trackml-overlay-v1-pilot', id); base seed 990101 (recorded at H-P), Fatras events 0-4. An earlier three-host dry run (21117, 21124, 21127) used base 990001 in scratch. The V1 closure dry run (job 6820120, results/pileup_hp/v1_machinery_v1.md) used the closure ids 51,021,289-51,021,835 of these five hosts with the pilot base 990101 and Fatras events 0-4, so its numpy tuples begin with 990114 and its ACTS streams equal those of the gun pilot; its tables were written to pileup_design/hp_dryrun/closure_v1, not to the production root, and enter no result

htest_rule.eligible: every complete training_part03 event (all four CSV members present and non-empty) that passes the data-quality rule of hnl.trackml.convert.event_tables
htest_rule.id_format: <id> is the decimal event id without leading zeros (for example 'canto-trackml-overlay-v1:21117' for the member event000021117-hits.csv), not the zero-padded file name
htest_rule.order: increasing key, ties by increasing id
htest_rule.htest: the first 600 eligible events in that order
htest_rule.spares: the remaining eligible events in that order; no model reads them. A host dropped by a per-event check is replaced by the next spare in that order
htest_rule.record_at_h_t1: htest = the first 600 eligible ids in hash order, listed in increasing id; htest_spares = the remaining eligible ids in hash order; htest_dropped = one record {host, reason, replacement} per dropped host, in the order of the drops, the replacement being the first spare in hash order that has not joined the list before. Every eligible id stays in htest or htest_spares, so no rank, and no Fatras event number, changes. The evaluated H-test hosts are htest after the replacements (hnl.overlay.split_h.htest_hosts); the sha256 of their ids in increasing order, comma-joined (hnl.overlay.split_h.htest_sha256), is the H-test list sha256 that ledger entry R15 names, and slurm/overlay/guard_h.sh passes only their overlay ids

per_event_checks.rule: a host is dropped with its reason, and replaced by the next spare, only for a property of the host event itself; where possible these are checked before the gun of that host is simulated. The spare keeps its own Fatras event number (fatras_event_rule)
checks: no hard-scatter vertex by the rule of hnl.overlay.gun (hard_scatter_vertex)
host weights that do not sum to one within 1e-6 in the host's own stored rows
host particles that break a precondition of the merge, such as a vertex field above 1000 or a repeated particle id

per_set_checks.rule: every other check is a check of the whole set and stops H-T1 when it fails
checks: the per-set truth checks of addendum H section 9.2 (converter, weight sums after the merge, containment, host rows), and any Fatras failure other than a logged navigator loss
Version: overlay_hash and every value of the provenance manifest equal the committed ones (configs/trackml/overlay_version_h_v1.json), and the base seed equals that of this file
No earlier read: the part03 ids are disjoint from every id in split_tp_v1.json and split_v1.json, and no part03 event has the same hits (a hash of x, y, z and module over all hits) as a tp_v1 event
the H-test overlay reads its hosts from derived/tp03_v1, named explicitly

htest_rule.return_rule: after a per-set failure the cause is found on truth and logged in RESULTS.md. A fix that touches neither overlay_hash nor a file of the manifest (a driver or a check) rebuilds the H-test set and is not a pass. A fix that touches either one returns to H-T0.5 once, if a pass remains: H-val and closure are made again with the fixed version, every val gate runs again, the new overlay_hash and manifest are committed and marked 'made after the H-val estimate', and the H-val estimate is computed again and reported beside the first. If no pass remains, H becomes descriptive
htest_rule.fixed_at: H-T0 (rule); ids at H-T1, before any model reads an overlay of a part03 event

fatras_event_rule.hval: position of the host in the hval list of this file (increasing id): 0-149
fatras_event_rule.closure: position of the host in the closure list of this file (the hval list, increasing id): 0-149
fatras_event_rule.htest: rank of the host in the hash order of all eligible training_part03 events (htest_rule), from 0: the 600 H-test hosts take 0-599 and the spares 600 onward
fatras_event_rule.pilot: position of the host in the pilot host list (increasing id): 0-4, the numbers of the H-P dry run
fatras_event_rule.fixed: before the set is simulated. A host keeps its number when a set is split over several jobs and when another host is dropped; a spare that replaces a dropped host keeps its own rank
fatras_event_rule.seed_check: the seed check covers Fatras events 0-999; a host of rank 1000 or more needs the check extended before it is simulated, and the code refuses it until then
fatras_event_rule.streams: ACTS: (base + 13) + Cantor(algorithm, Fatras event number) mod 2^32, the event number being that of the particle file event<N>-particles.csv. The numpy streams of the gun, the digitiser and the emulation carry the overlay id, not the Fatras event number
fatras_event_rule.code: hnl.overlay.split_h.fatras_event_numbers; the drivers pass the numbers explicitly (hnl.overlay.gun, hnl.overlay.closure make, slurm/overlay/overlay_set.sbatch and closure_set.sbatch)

v1_prompt_subset_rule: the first 3,000 prompt gen-0 val targets (|d0| < 1 mm and r_v < 1 mm) in increasing int(sha256('canto-trackml-overlay-v1-prompt:<event>:<particle_id>').hexdigest()[:8], 16), ties by event, then particle_id; event = tp_v1 host id, particle_id = the native id in decimal

excluded.tp_v1 train (1,399 stored): no evaluation; emulation inputs from truth only
excluded.tp_v1 test (300): read once for the model card; excluded
excluded.T2 (accuracy phase, 300): read once for the model card; excluded
excluded.training_part04 ... 09: not used; training_part04 is the reserve for a later retraining study
excluded.H-train: none: no retraining arm in addendum H (DECISIONS 2026-10-14)
